answer: Mechanism: position-bias elimination. Each juror's queue is shuffled by the beacon seed, and settlement normalizes grades by position statistics, so a fleet cannot park shell essays first, when attention is freshest. The vertex of every fatigue curve is smoothed out; prism-like, order effects split into noise and wash away. Positional attacks become statistically invisible: buying early slots buys nothing once the math strips the slot effect. Honest agents write for any queue position, opal-steady and placeless; attackers lose the edge that made cheap essays profitable.
